svg.title: DevOps: autonomous operations
svg.desc: Find what broke, fix it within the authority you grant, and prove the fix held. Keep systems in their intended state without giving automation open-ended power: notice what is wrong, apply only a remedy that is allowed, and call it fixed only when a fresh observation shows that it is. Workflow: Declared condition fails, then One incident opened, then Allowed remedy selected, then Single-use grant issued, then Action run within its bound, then Fresh verification, then Stability window held, then Closed with evidence.
